records.sourceLocator: Abstract; Sections 2–3, semiclassical and stochastic gravity
records.evidenceNote: The Einstein–Langevin description extends mean stress-energy sourcing by a stress-tensor noise kernel. The extension is an effective treatment of fluctuations, not full quantum geometry.

records.sourceLocator: Section 2, semiclassical gravity
records.evidenceNote: Renormalized quantum stress-energy on curved spacetime supplies the matter expectation value in the semiclassical Einstein equation. Backreaction adds dynamics to the background-field setting.

records.sourceLocator: Review discussion of particle creation and the Hawking effect
records.evidenceNote: The Hawking effect is an application of quantum field theory on a classical curved background; this link does not assert a full quantum-gravity calculation.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and black-hole temperature discussion
records.evidenceNote: Hawking radiation supplies a physical temperature proportional to surface gravity, connecting horizon mechanics with thermodynamics. The edge records that connection, not historical priority.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract; Section 2, Complementarity is not enough
records.evidenceNote: AMPS challenge the simultaneous assumptions of pure radiation, semiclassical exterior physics and smooth infall. The challenge is conditional and does not establish an observed firewall.

records.sourceLocator: Review discussion of the information paradox and islands
records.evidenceNote: JT gravity supplies tractable settings for island calculations. Support is restricted to the model and its specified matter and boundary conditions.

records.sourceLocator: Introduction, replica limit n → 1
records.evidenceNote: Replica-connected saddles lead to an island contribution after analytic continuation in replica number in the models studied.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and Section 2, JT gravity setup
records.evidenceNote: The paper demonstrates replica-wormhole contributions using JT gravity coupled to matter and a nongravitating bath.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and canonical constraint construction
records.evidenceNote: Canonical quantization of geometric variables leads to wavefunctional gravitational constraints, including the Wheeler–DeWitt equation.

records.sourceLocator: Appendix A, derivation for a Friedmann universe
records.evidenceNote: Restricting geometry to a homogeneous cosmological model reduces the Wheeler–DeWitt equation to minisuperspace variables. This is a symmetry reduction, not an exact replacement for all geometries.

records.sourceLocator: Summary and Appendix A
records.evidenceNote: The review develops quantum cosmology within geometrodynamics using Wheeler–DeWitt equations and boundary conditions. Other quantum-cosmology approaches need not use this formulation.

records.sourceLocator: Discussion of two entangled AdS black holes
records.evidenceNote: Entangled AdS black holes provide a concrete setting for relating entanglement to a nontraversable bridge. The extension to general entangled systems is conjectural.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and proposed generalization
records.evidenceNote: The proposed entanglement–bridge relation links quantum correlations with geometry; its generalization is a conjecture rather than an established construction of arbitrary spacetime.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and large-N near-horizon limits
records.evidenceNote: In the controlled low-energy regimes discussed, string constructions admit a supergravity description. This records a regime-dependent overlap, not equality of the complete theories.

records.sourceLocator: Abstract and AdS/CFT proposal
records.evidenceNote: The proposed AdS dual pairs provide a string-theoretic realization of holographic ideas. They do not prove a holographic description for every spacetime.

records.sourceLocator: Almheiri, Dong and Harlow: abstract and code-subspace construction
records.evidenceNote: The bulk-reconstruction proposal relates subregion encoding in AdS/CFT to operator-algebra quantum error correction, with limits set by the code subspace.

records.sourceLocator: Almheiri et al.: abstract and radiation entropy prescription
records.evidenceNote: The entropy problem of Hawking radiation motivates an island prescription yielding a Page curve in controlled holographic evaporation models. An entropy calculation is not a general decoding protocol.

records.sourceLocator: Spin-foam review: covariant dynamics and relation to canonical loop gravity
records.evidenceNote: Spin-foam state sums provide a covariant route to dynamics related to loop-quantum-gravity boundary states; a complete equivalence of every formulation is not asserted.
